title: Oozy Peruvian Chickpea Causa Limena
description: A creamy, plant-based Peruvian causa made with chickpea flour, lime, and a smoky paprika dressing, perfect for a comforting sick day meal.
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine chickpea flour, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and water to form a thick batter.
Stir until the mixture is smooth and free of lumps, then cover and let rest for 10 minutes.
While batter rests, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, and roasted garlic to create a tangy dressing.
After resting, fold the dressing into the batter until fully incorporated.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat, lightly oil it, and pour 1/4 cup of batter, flattening into a round patty.
Cook each side for 3 minutes until golden and firm, then remove and slice into thick strips.
In a bowl, combine sliced cucumber, red onion, and lime zest, then season with a pinch of salt.
Assemble the causa by layering the chickpea strips, cucumber mix, and a drizzle of the lime dressing, then serve immediately.
